# Wellness City Lucknow Plots

> Independent resale service for plots in Wellness City, the Lucknow Development Authority (LDA) "Medi City" between Sultanpur Road and Kisan Path, Lucknow. Not the official LDA website. Updated 10 November 2026.

## Key facts
- Planned area: about 1,474 acres in total; phase 1 is 485 ha (about 1,198 acres) in 7 villages of Mohanlalganj tehsil: Bakkas, Malukpur Dhakwa, Chaurahiya, Chaurasi, Dularmau, Noorpur Behta, Mastemau
- Project cost: ₹1,441.26 crore, 40% funded by the state government
- Phase-1 layout: about 150 acres for hospitals and a medical college, about 2,000 LDA plots on 76.83 acres, 362.41 acres of group housing, about 200 acres of parks, 57.10 acres commercial; plan to move the Aminabad wholesale medicine market here
- Proposed land rate: ₹54,559.17 per m² (about ₹5,100 per sq ft), LDA finance controller's order of 30 June 2026; not final. The LDA secretary said on 27 Oct 2026 the public rate may be above ₹5,500 per sq ft
- Plots sold here: from the first land-pooling lottery of 30 June 2026 (125 plots to 59 landowners: 86 of 288 m², 4 of 200, 5 of 162, 9 of 128, 7 of 72, 14 of 35 m²)
- Transfer rule: phase-1 land notified under Section 11 on 5 June 2026; a transfer needs the District Collector's prior written permission. Permission status is shared for each plot with its price
- LDA public scheme: no brochure or registration date as of 10 November 2026
- Location: about 0.5 km from the Purvanchal Expressway (LDA); ~12.4 km from Hazratganj, 14.3 km from Charbagh, 17.8 km from the airport, 5.9 km from IT City (straight line)
- Contact: WhatsApp / call +91 85950 02933
- Page: https://lucknowwellnesscity.in/

## Plot sizes and base cost at the proposed rate (before 12% freehold and other charges)
- 35 m² (377 sq ft, 42 sq yd): ≈ ₹19.1 lakh
- 72 m² (775 sq ft, 86 sq yd): ≈ ₹39.3 lakh
- 128 m² (1,378 sq ft, 153 sq yd): ≈ ₹69.8 lakh
- 162 m² (1,744 sq ft, 194 sq yd): ≈ ₹88.4 lakh
- 200 m² (2,153 sq ft, 239 sq yd): ≈ ₹109.1 lakh
- 288 m² (3,100 sq ft, 344 sq yd): ≈ ₹157.1 lakh
